# SortableJS — bundled browser dependency

- Project: https://github.com/SortableJS/Sortable
- Version: 1.15.7 (tag `1.15.7`)
- Distribution: `Sortable.min.js` from upstream release tag
- Original Git blob SHA: `8148b9dda22424c300191fcd3fcff1648de41e2e`
- License: MIT (`sortablejs-LICENSE.txt`)

ATGV bundles the upstream browser build directly in the VSIX. End users do not install Node.js, npm, packages or remote scripts to use Project Manager Kanban. The library is loaded exclusively from the extension's trusted `media/vendor` directory, without a CDN or runtime download.
